science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea

horizon_goals.immediate_session_goal: Navigate the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea without losing the supply crate.
horizon_goals.mid_term_milestone: Map the shifting currents of the ferrofluid sea.
horizon_goals.campaign_arc_climax: Integrate the Enclave's natural defenses with the digital twin.

active_location.macro_silhouette: The basalt ridge overlooking the ferrofluid sea is blasted by shifting magnetic winds that tug at metallic gear. Dark, metallic waves crash below, folding in on themselves in mesmerizing, turbulent Kelvin-Helmholtz shear patterns. The glowing spore-fog illuminates the cresting magnetic peaks in eerie, shifting shades of violet.

sensory_palette.sight_and_color: Eerie violet spore-glow and pitch-black metallic waves
sensory_palette.sound: Deep, resonant humming and the crash of heavy, liquid iron
sensory_palette.tactile_temperature: Biting cold wind laden with static electricity
sensory_palette.taste_optional: Copper and ash on the tongue

interactive_features.affordance_description: A sturdy rock formation that can be used to anchor against the magnetic shear.
A lost supply crate caught in a magnetic eddy, waiting to be hooked.
A dense cluster of spores that can be disturbed to mask a heat signature.

reactive_toys.motivation_goal: Destabilize and swallow anything metallic on the shoreline
reactive_toys.immediate_complication: The shear is pulling the iron-wood crate further into the sea
reactive_toys.uninterrupted_escalation: The vortex expands, dragging shoreline debris into the crushing depths

three_levels_of_why.level_1_immediate: The fluctuating magnetic shear is threatening to pull the supply crate away.
three_levels_of_why.level_2_local: The ferrofluid sea's currents are becoming increasingly erratic and hostile to navigation.
three_levels_of_why.level_3_campaign_arc: The Enclave's presence is triggering a defensive response from the exoplanet's core.

judge_tactician.failure_stakes_declared: If Kaio fails to secure the crate, it will be lost to the ferrofluid sea, and the resulting magnetic backlash will damage his gear.

graduated_outcomes.nat_1_false_intuition: Kaio misreads the magnetic eddy, diving directly into a crushing shear wave.
graduated_outcomes.below_dc_complicated_fail_forward: Kaio secures the crate but his compass and grappling hook are heavily magnetized and ruined.
graduated_outcomes.meets_dc_clean_success: Kaio deftly hooks the crate and pulls it to the safety of the basalt outcropping.
graduated_outcomes.dc_plus_5_or_20_extended_lore: Kaio rescues the crate and discovers a stable magnetic corridor through the shear.

master_narrator.agency_handoff_prompt: The biting wind whipped Kaio's hair around his goggles as he braced against the magnetized basalt, tracking the iron-wood crate's erratic path. The heavy, dark waves of the ferrofluid sea crashed and folded in beautiful, terrifying Kelvin-Helmholtz shear patterns. 'It's drifting too fast!' Kaio shouted over the resonant hum of the sea, reeling his grappling line back in. He scrambled up the slick rock face, pulling a glowing, spore-dusted marker buoy from his satchel. He shoved the heavy brass buoy into the hands of Ryn, who was hauling himself up the ridge. 'You need to throw this dead-center into the eddy so we can track the submerged currents before we lose the rations!' Ryn gripped the cold brass, eyeing the treacherous vortex below.
